en.t: The sun had already risen high, and the waiting women gathered in a crowd.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言深恐居留太久，被人疑心有何隐事，便准备回去。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, feared that if he stayed too long people would suspect some hidden matter, so he prepared to leave.

units.source_text: 他说：“我无论到何处，总不坐在帘外。

en.t: He said, "Wherever I go, I never sit outside the blinds.
Today I feel very ill at ease.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，今后定当再来访问。”说罢起身告辞。

en.t: Even so, I shall certainly come to call again another time." With that, he rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 他深知匂亲王的性情，怕他日后知道了，疑心他为何在主人出门期间来访，不大妥当。

en.t: He knew Prince Niou's nature well, and feared it would be awkward if the prince later learned of this visit and wondered why he had come while the master was away.

units.source_text: 就召唤这里的家臣长官右京大夫来前，对他说道：“我听说亲王昨夜已经回府，所以前来访问。

en.t: So he summoned Ukyo no Taifu, the chief steward of the household, and said to him, "I heard that His Highness returned to his residence last night, and therefore came to call.

units.source_text: 原来尚未归家，实甚遗憾。

en.t: I am truly sorry to find that he has not yet come home.

units.source_text: 此刻我将入宫，或可在宫中相见。”右京大夫答道：“今天就要回来的。”

en.t: I am going to the palace now, so perhaps I may meet him there." Ukyo no Taifu replied, "He is expected to return today."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“那么我傍晚再来吧。”

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "Then I shall come again this evening."
Having said this, he went out.
